docs.text: Precipitation has been below normal for much of the U.S. in the first third of 2026. Parts of the western Great Plains and the Southeast have received 50% or less of normal. Precip was much above normal around the Great Lakes. #precipitation 🧪 hprcc.unl.edu/maps.php?map...
March 2025 was a mostly unremarkable month for precipitation. Record high precipitation in the upper Great Lakes and the lower Rio Grande valley. Dry in the mid-Atlantic.

PNW dry
